name: The Ritz Carlton Doha
insider_take: This ultra-luxe waterfront palace sits on its own private island in West Bay Lagoon, offering unparalleled views of Doha's glittering skyline and the Arabian Gulf.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Doha features the region's largest chandelier in its soaring lobby, crafted from over 40,000 Swarovski crystals. The hotel's unique location on a man-made island means every room offers stunning water views, while the property houses Qatar's first underwater restaurant, STK Doha, accessible via a dramatic glass tunnel beneath the lagoon.
pro_tip: Book the Club Level for access to the exclusive 40th-floor Club Lounge, which offers the best panoramic views in the city and complimentary sunset cocktails with unobstructed vistas of the Corniche.
dont_miss: The hotel's private beach club with imported white sand, and the nearby Museum of Islamic Art (just 5 minutes away) designed by I.M. Pei. Time your visit for dhow boat rides at sunset from the hotel's marina, offering magical views of Doha's futuristic skyline reflecting in the calm lagoon waters.
pros: Prime waterfront location with stunning Arabian Gulf views
Exceptional luxury amenities including world-class spa and fitness facilities
Multiple award-winning dining venues with international cuisine
Impeccable Ritz-Carlton service standards and attention to detail
cons: Located in busy business district with limited nearby attractions
